target_definition: trip_count grouped by pickup Taxi Zone ID and pickup hour

method_notes.split: Chronological 8:2 split, not random row split, to better simulate forecasting.
method_notes.neural_network: MLP can model nonlinear interactions but requires tuning and sufficient data.
method_notes.random_forest: Strong tabular baseline; less tuning, often robust on small/medium structured data, but less extrapolative over unseen time patterns.
